business_problem: Picsart democratizes visual content with intuitive, AI-powered photo and video editing tools for billions. Leveraging Google Cloud, Gemini platform, and Gemini models, they seamlessly scale and rapidly deploy advanced automated editing features.
solution_summary: Picsart democratizes visual content with intuitive, AI-powered photo and video editing tools for billions. Leveraging Google Cloud, Gemini platform, and Gemini models, they seamlessly scale and rapidly deploy advanced automated editing features. Today, Picsart has scaled into a creative content powerhouse, boasting over 2.5 billion installs worldwide. The platform empowers a highly diverse global user base, ranging from Gen Z teenagers and social media influencers to solopreneurs selling items on Etsy. However, transitioning from simple manual photo filters to automated asset generation created massive behind-the-scenes technical challenges. Supporting token-intensive, video-based workloads required an incredibly agile backend ecosystem. Picsart needed infrastructure capable of rapid, near-real-time scaling to handle intense spikes in usage without inflating costs.
